SapModel.LoadCases.ChangeName.parameter_notes: Name: str — existing load case name; NewName: str — new unique name
SapModel.LoadCases.ChangeName.notes: Returns ret_code directly (0=success). Verify with GetNameList after renaming.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.Count.description: Get total number of load patterns
SapModel.LoadPatterns.Count.notes: Returns count directly as integer. Blank model has at least 1 pattern (DEAD).

SapModel.LoadPatterns.Delete.parameter_notes: Name: str — name of existing load pattern to delete
SapModel.LoadPatterns.Delete.notes: Returns ret_code directly (0=success). Cannot delete the last remaining load pattern. IMPORTANT: must delete the auto-created load case (LoadCases.Delete) before deleting the pattern, otherwise returns ret=1.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.ChangeName.parameter_notes: Name: str — existing load pattern name; NewName: str — new unique name
SapModel.LoadPatterns.ChangeName.notes: Returns ret_code directly (0=success). Verify with GetNameList after renaming.

SapModel.SourceMass.SetMassSource.description: Add or reinitialize a mass source definition specifying which elements and load patterns contribute to model mass. Essential for seismic and modal analysis workflows.
SapModel.SourceMass.SetMassSource.signature: (Name, MassFromElements, MassFromMasses, MassFromLoads, IsDefault, NumberLoads, LoadPat[], SF[])
SapModel.SourceMass.SetMassSource.parameter_notes: Name: str, MassFromElements: bool, MassFromMasses: bool, MassFromLoads: bool, IsDefault: bool, NumberLoads: int, LoadPat: str[], SF: float[]
SapModel.SourceMass.SetMassSource.notes: Returns [LoadPat[], SF[], ret_code] — ByRef echo. Use raw[-1] for return code. Verified 2026-03-28.

SapModel.SourceMass.Count.description: Get total number of mass sources defined in the model. Returns integer directly (not ByRef).
SapModel.SourceMass.Count.notes: Returns integer directly. Blank model has 1 default mass source ('MSSSRC1'). Verified 2026-03-28.

SapModel.SourceMass.GetMassSource.description: Retrieve mass source configuration including element/load contributions and scale factors. Returns ByRef layout with all settings.
SapModel.SourceMass.GetMassSource.signature: (Name, MassFromElements, MassFromMasses, MassFromLoads, IsDefault, NumberLoads, LoadPat[], SF[])
SapModel.SourceMass.GetMassSource.parameter_notes: Name: str — Existing mass source name. Pass dummy values for ByRef outputs.
SapModel.SourceMass.GetMassSource.notes: ByRef layout: [MassFromElements, MassFromMasses, MassFromLoads, IsDefault, NumberLoads, LoadPat(), SF(), ret_code]. Verified 2026-03-28.

SapModel.SourceMass.GetDefault.description: Retrieve the name of the default mass source currently set in the model.
SapModel.SourceMass.GetDefault.parameter_notes: Pass empty string '' as placeholder for ByRef Name output.
SapModel.SourceMass.GetDefault.notes: ByRef layout: [Name, ret_code]. Default mass source is 'MSSSRC1' in blank models. Verified 2026-03-28.

SapModel.FrameObj.SetModifiers.description: Set stiffness modification factors for a frame object (cracked section analysis)
SapModel.FrameObj.SetModifiers.parameter_notes: Name: str — frame object name; Value: float[8] — [Area, AS2, AS3, Torsion, I22, I33, Mass, Weight]
SapModel.FrameObj.SetModifiers.notes: Returns [Value[8], ret_code] — ByRef pattern. Use raw[-1] for ret_code. Common ACI 318 values: beams I22=I33=0.35, columns I22=I33=0.70.

SapModel.FrameObj.GetModifiers.description: Retrieve stiffness modification factors for a frame object
SapModel.FrameObj.GetModifiers.parameter_notes: Name: str — frame object name; Value: float[8] — placeholder [0.0]*8 required. Returns [Value[8], ret_code].
SapModel.FrameObj.GetModifiers.notes: Pass [0.0]*8 as placeholder for ByRef Value parameter. Returns [Value[8], ret_code].

SapModel.PropArea.SetModifiers.description: Set stiffness modification factors for an area property (shell/slab/wall)
SapModel.PropArea.SetModifiers.parameter_notes: Name: str — area section name; Value: float[10] — [f11, f22, f12, m11, m22, m12, v13, v23, mass, weight]
SapModel.PropArea.SetModifiers.notes: Returns [Value[10], ret_code] — ByRef pattern. Use raw[-1] for ret_code. Array: [f11, f22, f12, m11, m22, m12, v13, v23, mass, weight].

SapModel.PropArea.GetModifiers.description: Retrieve stiffness modification factors for an area property
SapModel.PropArea.GetModifiers.parameter_notes: Name: str — area section name; Value: float[10] — placeholder [0.0]*10 required. Returns [Value[10], ret_code].
SapModel.PropArea.GetModifiers.notes: Pass [0.0]*10 as placeholder for ByRef Value parameter. Returns [Value[10], ret_code].

SapModel.PropFrame.ChangeName.parameter_notes: Name: str — existing section name; NewName: str — new section name
SapModel.PropFrame.ChangeName.notes: Direct return code (not ByRef). Old name must exist. New name must be unique.

SapModel.PropFrame.Count.description: Get total number of frame section properties (optionally filtered by type)
SapModel.PropFrame.Count.parameter_notes: PropType: int (optional) — 0=All section types. Returns integer count directly.
SapModel.PropFrame.Count.notes: Direct integer return (not a list). No arguments required for all types. PropType arg: 0=All, 1=ISection, 2=Channel, 3=Tee, 4=Angle, 6=Box, 7=Pipe, 8=Rect, 9=Circle.

SapModel.PropFrame.Delete.description: Delete a frame section property (must not be in use by any element)
SapModel.PropFrame.Delete.parameter_notes: Name: str — name of the frame section to delete
SapModel.PropFrame.Delete.notes: Direct return code. Fails if section is assigned to any frame object.

SapModel.PropMaterial.ChangeName.parameter_notes: Name: str — existing material name; NewName: str — new material name
SapModel.PropMaterial.ChangeName.notes: Direct return code. Old name must exist. New name must be unique.

SapModel.PropMaterial.Count.description: Get total number of material properties (optionally filtered by material type)
SapModel.PropMaterial.Count.parameter_notes: MatType: int (optional) — 0=All material types. Returns integer count directly.
SapModel.PropMaterial.Count.notes: Direct integer return (not a list). MatType arg: 0=All, 1=Steel, 2=Concrete, 3=Aluminum, 4=ColdFormed, 5=Rebar, 6=Tendon, 7=Other.

SapModel.PropMaterial.Delete.description: Delete a material property (must not be in use by any section)
SapModel.PropMaterial.Delete.parameter_notes: Name: str — name of the material to delete
SapModel.PropMaterial.Delete.notes: Direct return code. Fails if material is used by any frame or area section.

SapModel.PropLink.SetGap.description: Define a Gap-type nonlinear link property (compression-only). DOF arrays size 6.
SapModel.PropLink.SetGap.signature: (Name, DOF, Fixed, Ke, Nonlinear, GapOpens, Opens, Notes, GUID) -> ret_code
SapModel.PropLink.SetGap.parameter_notes: Order: Name, DOF[6], Fixed[6], NonLinear[6], Ke[6], Ce[6], k[6], dis[6], dj2, dj3. Returns Long (0=OK). NonLinear MUST come before Ke/Ce.

SapModel.PropLink.Count.description: Get the number of link/support properties defined
SapModel.PropLink.Count.parameter_notes: No inputs. Returns integer count directly.

SapModel.AreaObj.AddByPoint.description: Add an area object by specifying existing point names
SapModel.AreaObj.AddByPoint.signature: (NumberPoints, Point, PropName, Name, UserName, CSys) -> ret_code
SapModel.AreaObj.AddByPoint.parameter_notes: NumberPoints: int — number of vertices; Point: str[] — corner point names; PropName: str — section property; Name: str — (ByRef out) assigned name; UserName: str — optional user name
SapModel.AreaObj.AddByPoint.notes: ByRef layout: [Name, ret_code]. Pass '' for Name. Points must exist.

SapModel.ConstraintDef.GetNameList.description: Get names of all constraints defined in the model
SapModel.ConstraintDef.GetNameList.parameter_notes: NumberNames: int — (ByRef out) count; MyName: str[] — (ByRef out) constraint names

SapModel.AreaObj.GetNameList.description: Get names of all area objects in the model
SapModel.AreaObj.GetNameList.parameter_notes: NumberNames: int — (ByRef out) count; MyName: str[] — (ByRef out) names array
SapModel.AreaObj.GetNameList.notes: ByRef layout: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. Pass 0, [] as placeholders.

SapModel.GetPresentUnits.description: Get the current display units of the model
SapModel.GetPresentUnits.parameter_notes: No input parameters. Returns units enum integer.
SapModel.GetPresentUnits.notes: Returns integer directly (eUnits value). Not a list.

SapModel.PropMaterial.AddMaterial.description: Add a material from the built-in SAP2000 database
SapModel.PropMaterial.AddMaterial.parameter_notes: Region: str — region code (e.g. 'United States'); Standard: str — standard (e.g. 'ASTM'); Grade: str — grade (e.g. 'A992'); Name: str — (ByRef out) assigned name
SapModel.PropMaterial.AddMaterial.notes: ByRef layout: [Name, ret_code]. Pass '' for Name. Use for steel grades from library.

SapModel.PropMaterial.GetTypeOAPI.description: Get the material type (eMatType) for a material property
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetTypeOAPI.parameter_notes: Name: str — material name; MatType: int — (ByRef out) material type (1=Steel, 2=Concrete, etc.)
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetTypeOAPI.notes: ByRef layout: [MatType, ret_code]. Pass 0 as placeholder.

SapModel.AreaObj.GetGroupAssign.description: Get groups assigned to an area object
SapModel.AreaObj.GetGroupAssign.parameter_notes: Name: str — area name; NumberGroups: int — (ByRef out) group count; Groups: str[] — (ByRef out) group names; ItemType: int — 0=Object

SapModel.PointObj.GetRestraint.description: Get the restraint conditions for a point object
SapModel.PointObj.GetRestraint.parameter_notes: Name: str — point name; Value: bool[6] — (ByRef out) [UX,UY,UZ,RX,RY,RZ]; ItemType: int — 0=Object
SapModel.PointObj.GetRestraint.notes: ByRef layout: [Value[6], ret_code]. Pass [False]*6 as placeholder.

SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI.description: Get the load case type for a named load case
SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI.parameter_notes: Name: str — load case name; CaseType: int — (ByRef out) eLoadCaseType value
SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI.notes: ByRef layout: [CaseType, ret_code]. Pass 0 as placeholder.

SapModel.GetModelFilename.description: Get the current model file path
SapModel.GetModelFilename.parameter_notes: IncludePath: bool — True=full path, False=filename only
SapModel.GetModelFilename.notes: Returns string directly (not a list). Empty string if model unsaved.

SapModel.SetModelIsLocked.notes: Returns ret_code directly (0=success). Unlocking deletes analysis results.

SapModel.FrameObj.GetNameList.description: Get names of all frame objects in the model
SapModel.FrameObj.GetNameList.parameter_notes: NumberNames: int — (ByRef out) count; MyName: str[] — (ByRef out) names array
SapModel.FrameObj.GetNameList.notes: ByRef layout: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. Pass 0, [] as placeholders.

SapModel.FrameObj.Delete.description: Delete a frame object from the model
SapModel.FrameObj.Delete.parameter_notes: Name: str — frame name or group; ItemType: int — 0=Object, 1=Group, 2=Selection
SapModel.FrameObj.Delete.notes: Returns ret_code directly. Also deletes loads assigned to the frame.

SapModel.AreaObj.Delete.description: Delete an area object from the model
SapModel.AreaObj.Delete.parameter_notes: Name: str — area name or group; ItemType: int — 0=Object, 1=Group, 2=Selection
SapModel.AreaObj.Delete.notes: Returns ret_code directly. Also deletes loads assigned to the area.

SapModel.PointObj.GetLoadForce.description: Get point loads assigned to a joint
SapModel.PointObj.GetLoadForce.signature: (Name, NumberItems, PatternName, ItemType, DOF, Value, CSys) -> ret_code
SapModel.PointObj.GetLoadForce.parameter_notes: Name: str — joint name or 'All'; NumberItems: int — (ByRef out) count; PatternName: str[] — (ByRef out); ItemType: int — 0=Object
SapModel.PointObj.GetLoadForce.notes: ByRef layout: [NumberItems, PatternName[], ItemType[], DOF[], Value[], CSys[], ret_code].

SapModel.LinkObj.SetProperty.description: Assign a link property to a link object, a group, or the selected links
SapModel.LinkObj.SetProperty.parameter_notes: Name = link object, group, or ignored when ItemType is selected. PropName = an existing link property. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.LinkObj.SetProperty.notes: No ByRef outputs. Define the property with PropLink.SetLinear or a related setter before assigning it, otherwise the call fails.

SapModel.Results.AreaForceShell.description: Retrieve the shell forces and moments at the joints of area elements
SapModel.Results.AreaForceShell.signature: (Name, ItemTypeElm, NumberResults, Obj, Elm, PointElm, LoadCase, StepType, StepNum, F11, F22, F12, FMax, FMin, FAngle, FVM, M11, M22, M12, MMax, MMin, MAngle, V13, V23, VMax, VAngle) -> [NumberResults, Obj[], Elm[], PointElm[], LoadCase[], StepType[], StepNum[], F11[], F22[], F12[], FMax[], FMin[], FAngle[], FVM[], M11[], M22[], M12[], MMax[], MMin[], MAngle[], V13[], V23[], VMax[], VAngle[], ret_code]
SapModel.Results.AreaForceShell.parameter_notes: Name = area object or element, group, or ignored when selecting. ItemTypeElm: 0 object, 1 element, 2 group, 3 selected objects. F11, F22 and F12 = membrane forces per unit length, with principal values FMax and FMin at angle FAngle and von Mises FVM. M11, M22 and M12 = bending moments per unit length, with principal values MMax and MMin at angle MAngle. V13 and V23 = transverse shears per unit length, with resultant VMax at angle VAngle. Results are reported at each joint of each element, so one element yields several rows.
SapModel.Results.AreaForceShell.notes: ByRef output: NumberResults then 23 parallel arrays then ret_code. Select the output cases with Results.Setup first, otherwise NumberResults is 0 with ret_code 0, which looks like success but means no case was selected. Forces and moments are per unit length, not totals, so integrate over the strip width before comparing against a design table.

SapModel.PointObj.SetSpring.description: Assign six uncoupled spring stiffnesses to a point object, a group, or the selected points
SapModel.PointObj.SetSpring.parameter_notes: K = array of 6 stiffnesses in the order U1, U2, U3, R1, R2, R3, in the present units. IsLocalCSys True applies them in the point local system, False in the global system. Replace True removes existing springs first, False adds to them. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.PointObj.SetSpring.notes: K is declared ByRef in the API but carries no output, so pass a 6-element list. Springs and restraints can coexist on the same point, and a restrained degree of freedom makes its spring irrelevant.

SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_1.description: Retrieve the solver options, reporting the force 32-bit solver flag
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_1.signature: (SolverType, SolverProcessType, Force32BitSolver, StiffCase) -> [SolverType, SolverProcessType, Force32BitSolver, StiffCase, ret_code]
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_1.parameter_notes: SolverType: 0 standard, 1 advanced, 2 multi-threaded. SolverProcessType: 0 auto, 1 GUI process, 2 separate process. Force32BitSolver = Boolean. StiffCase = load case whose mass and stiffness matrices are written to text files, blank means none.
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_1.notes: Oldest of the three overloads. Superseded by GetSolverOption_3, which reports parallel runs, response file size and analysis threads instead of the 32-bit flag. ByRef output: 4 values then ret_code.

SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_2.description: Retrieve the solver options, reporting the number of parallel runs
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_2.signature: (SolverType, SolverProcessType, NumberParallelRuns, StiffCase) -> [SolverType, SolverProcessType, NumberParallelRuns, StiffCase, ret_code]
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_2.parameter_notes: SolverType: 0 standard, 1 advanced, 2 multi-threaded. SolverProcessType: 0 auto, 1 GUI process, 2 separate process. NumberParallelRuns: 0 auto parallel, 1 serial, 2 to 8 fixed core count. StiffCase = load case whose matrices are written to text files, blank means none.
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_2.notes: Middle overload. Superseded by GetSolverOption_3. ByRef output: 4 values then ret_code.

SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_3.description: Retrieve the current solver options, including parallel runs, response file size limit and analysis threads
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_3.signature: (SolverType, SolverProcessType, NumberParallelRuns, ResponseFileSizeMaxMB, NumberAnalysisThreads, StiffCase) -> [SolverType, SolverProcessType, NumberParallelRuns, ResponseFileSizeMaxMB, NumberAnalysisThreads, StiffCase, ret_code]
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_3.parameter_notes: SolverType: 0 standard, 1 advanced, 2 multi-threaded. SolverProcessType: 0 auto, 1 GUI process, 2 separate process. NumberParallelRuns: 0 auto parallel, 1 serial, 2 to 8 fixed core count. ResponseFileSizeMaxMB and NumberAnalysisThreads are positive when user specified and negative when program determined. StiffCase = load case whose matrices are written to text files.
SapModel.Analyze.GetSolverOption_3.notes: Current overload, use this one for new code. ByRef output: 6 values then ret_code.

SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_2.description: Set the solver type, process type, number of parallel runs and stiffness output case
SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_2.parameter_notes: SolverType: 0 standard, 1 advanced, 2 multi-threaded. SolverProcessType: 0 auto, 1 GUI process, 2 separate process. NumberParallelRuns: 0 auto parallel, 1 serial, 2 to 8 fixed core count, negative values from -8 to -2 behave as auto, and -1 is rejected. StiffCase is optional and defaults to blank, meaning no matrices are output.
SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_2.notes: Superseded by SetSolverOption_3. No ByRef outputs, so read the return code directly.

SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_3.description: Set the solver options, including parallel runs, response file size limit and number of analysis threads
SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_3.signature: (SolverType, SolverProcessType, NumberParallelRuns, ResponseFileSizeMaxMB, NumberAnalysisThreads, StiffCase) -> ret_code
SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_3.parameter_notes: SolverType: 0 standard, 1 advanced, 2 multi-threaded. SolverProcessType: 0 auto, 1 GUI process, 2 separate process. NumberParallelRuns: 0 auto parallel, 1 serial, 2 to 8 fixed core count, -1 is rejected. ResponseFileSizeMaxMB = size in MB before a new response file is started, negative for program determined. NumberAnalysisThreads negative for program determined. StiffCase optional, blank means no matrices are output.
SapModel.Analyze.SetSolverOption_3.notes: Current overload, use this one for new code. No ByRef outputs, so read the return code directly. Call before Analyze.RunAnalysis.

SapModel.LinkObj.GetNameList.description: Get the names of all link objects in the model
SapModel.LinkObj.GetNameList.parameter_notes: Both items are ByRef outputs. Call with placeholders, e.g. GetNameList(0, []).
SapModel.LinkObj.GetNameList.notes: ByRef output: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. Returns 0 names with ret_code 0 when the model has no links, so an empty list here is a real answer and not an error.

SapModel.LinkObj.GetPoints.description: Get the two end point objects of a link object
SapModel.LinkObj.GetPoints.parameter_notes: Name = existing link object. Point1 and Point2 are the names of the I-end and J-end point objects, returned ByRef.
SapModel.LinkObj.GetPoints.notes: ByRef output: [Point1, Point2, ret_code]. For a one-joint grounded link, Point1 is blank and only Point2 is connected.

SapModel.LinkObj.GetProperty.description: Get the link property assigned to a link object
SapModel.LinkObj.GetProperty.parameter_notes: Name = existing link object. PropName = name of the assigned link property, returned ByRef.
SapModel.LinkObj.GetProperty.notes: ByRef output: [PropName, ret_code]. The property itself is defined through SapModel.PropLink, for example PropLink.SetLinear.

SapModel.PropLink.GetNameList.description: Get the names of the link properties defined, optionally filtered by link type
SapModel.PropLink.GetNameList.parameter_notes: NumberNames and MyName are ByRef outputs, pass 0 and [] as placeholders. PropType is an optional eLinkPropType filter covering the link families such as linear, damper, gap, hook, multilinear elastic, multilinear plastic, rubber isolator and friction isolator.
SapModel.PropLink.GetNameList.notes: ByRef output: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. Link properties are definitions; the objects that use them are listed by LinkObj.GetNameList.

SapModel.GetProgramInfo.description: Get the name, version and licence level of the running program
SapModel.GetProgramInfo.parameter_notes: All three items are ByRef string outputs. ProgramName identifies the product, ProgramVersion the release, ProgramLevel the licence level such as Basic, Plus, Advanced or Ultimate.
SapModel.GetProgramInfo.notes: ByRef output: [ProgramName, ProgramVersion, ProgramLevel, ret_code]. More informative than SapModel.GetVersion, which returns the version string alone. Use it to gate features that need a higher licence level.

SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadUniform.description: Retrieve the uniform load assignments of an area object, a group, or all areas
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadUniform.signature: (Name, NumberItems, AreaName, LoadPat, CSys, Dir, Value, ItemType) -> [NumberItems, AreaName[], LoadPat[], CSys[], Dir[], Value[], ret_code]
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadUniform.parameter_notes: Name = area object, group, or ignored when ItemType is selected. Dir: 1 to 3 local axes, 4 to 6 global X Y Z, 7 to 9 projected global X Y Z, 10 gravity, 11 projected gravity. CSys is ignored for local and gravity directions. Value = load per unit area in the present units. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadUniform.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 5 parallel arrays then ret_code. One area can appear several times when it carries loads in more than one load pattern.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetSelfWTMultiplie.description: Get the self-weight multiplier of a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetSelfWTMultiplie.parameter_notes: Name = existing load pattern. SelfWTMultiplier = factor applied to the structure self weight in that pattern, returned ByRef. A value of 1 applies the full self weight, 0 applies none.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetSelfWTMultiplie.notes: ByRef output: [SelfWTMultiplier, ret_code]. Use it to check that exactly one pattern carries the self weight, since a multiplier accidentally left at 1 on two patterns doubles the dead load without any error.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetLoadType.description: Get the load pattern type of a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetLoadType.parameter_notes: Name = existing load pattern. MyType is an eLoadPatternType value returned ByRef, for example 1 dead, 2 superimposed dead, 3 live, 4 reducible live, 5 quake, 6 wind, 7 snow, 8 other.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetLoadType.notes: ByRef output: [MyType, ret_code]. LoadPatterns.GetNameList returns names and types together and is cheaper when scanning the whole model.

SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadTemperature.description: Retrieve the temperature load assignments of a frame object, a group, or all frames
SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadTemperature.signature: (Name, NumberItems, FrameName, LoadPat, MyType, Val, PatternName, ItemType) -> [NumberItems, FrameName[], LoadPat[], MyType[], Val[], PatternName[], ret_code]
SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadTemperature.parameter_notes: MyType: 1 uniform temperature change, 2 temperature gradient along local axis 2, 3 temperature gradient along local axis 3. Val = temperature or temperature gradient in the present units. PatternName = joint pattern that varies the temperature along the frame, blank when uniform. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadTemperature.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 5 parallel arrays then ret_code.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetUse.description: Retrieve the user coefficient auto seismic load parameters of a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetUse.signature: (Name, DirFlag, Eccen, UserZ, TopZ, BottomZ, C, K) -> [DirFlag, Eccen, UserZ, TopZ, BottomZ, C, K, ret_code]
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetUse.parameter_notes: Name = existing load pattern. DirFlag: 1 global X, 2 global Y, 3 global X with eccentricity, 4 global Y with eccentricity. Eccen = ratio of accidental eccentricity applied at all diaphragms. UserZ True means TopZ and BottomZ were user specified rather than program determined. TopZ and BottomZ = elevation range over which the load is applied. C = base shear coefficient. K = building height exponent.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetUse.notes: ByRef output: 7 values then ret_code. Base shear is C times the weight, distributed over height using the exponent K. Confirm the pattern actually uses this code first with LoadPatterns.GetAutoSeismicCode, since calling the wrong getter returns a nonzero code.

SapModel.PropMaterial.GetMassSource.description: Retrieve the model-wide mass source definition
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetMassSource.signature: (MyOption, NumberLoads, LoadPat, SF) -> [MyOption, NumberLoads, LoadPat[], SF[], ret_code]
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetMassSource.parameter_notes: MyOption: 1 mass from element self mass and additional masses, 2 mass from specified load patterns, 3 mass from both. LoadPat = the load patterns converted to mass. SF = multiplier applied to each of those patterns. LoadPat and SF come back empty when MyOption is 1.
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetMassSource.notes: ByRef output: MyOption, NumberLoads, 2 parallel arrays, then ret_code. It takes no name argument because it reads the single model-wide setting, despite living under PropMaterial. SapModel.SourceMass is the newer named mass source API and is what current models use.

SapModel.LoadCases.StaticLinear.GetLoads.description: Retrieve the load assignments of a linear static load case
SapModel.LoadCases.StaticLinear.GetLoads.signature: (Name, NumberLoads, LoadType, LoadName, SF) -> [NumberLoads, LoadType[], LoadName[], SF[], ret_code]
SapModel.LoadCases.StaticLinear.GetLoads.parameter_notes: Name = existing linear static load case. LoadType is Load, Accel or Link. LoadName is the load pattern name when LoadType is Load, or the direction such as UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY or RZ when LoadType is Accel. SF = scale factor applied to that load.
SapModel.LoadCases.StaticLinear.GetLoads.notes: ByRef output: NumberLoads then 3 parallel arrays then ret_code. Pairs with LoadCases.StaticLinear.SetLoads, which replaces the whole list rather than appending, so read first when adding a load to an existing case.

SapModel.LoadCases.ModalEigen.GetNumberM.description: Get the maximum and minimum number of modes requested for an eigen modal load case
SapModel.LoadCases.ModalEigen.GetNumberM.parameter_notes: Name = existing eigen modal load case. MaxModes = maximum number of modes to find. MinModes = minimum number of modes to find. Both are ByRef outputs.
SapModel.LoadCases.ModalEigen.GetNumberM.notes: ByRef output: [MaxModes, MinModes, ret_code]. These are the requested counts, not the number actually found. Read the modes the analysis produced with Results.ModalPeriod or ModalParticipatingMassRatios.

SapModel.DesignSteel.GetSummaryResults.description: Retrieve the steel design summary results for a frame, a group, or all frames
SapModel.DesignSteel.GetSummaryResults.signature: (Name, NumberItems, FrameName, Ratio, RatioType, Location, ComboName, ErrorSummary, WarningSummary, ItemType) -> [NumberItems, FrameName[], Ratio[], RatioType[], Location[], ComboName[], ErrorSummary[], WarningSummary[], ret_code]
SapModel.DesignSteel.GetSummaryResults.parameter_notes: Ratio = controlling demand over capacity ratio. RatioType: 1 PMM, 2 major shear, 3 minor shear, 4 major beam-column capacity, 5 minor beam-column capacity. Location = distance from the I-end where the controlling ratio occurs. ComboName = governing design combination. ErrorSummary and WarningSummary are blank when the member designed cleanly. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.DesignSteel.GetSummaryResults.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 7 parallel arrays then ret_code. Requires DesignSteel.StartDesign to have completed, otherwise it returns a nonzero code. Check ErrorSummary before trusting a Ratio, since a failed member can still report a number.

SapModel.DesignSteel.StartDesign.description: Run the steel frame design for the model
SapModel.DesignSteel.StartDesign.notes: Analysis results must already exist, and the design code and design combinations must be set first with DesignSteel.SetCode and DesignSteel.SetComboStrength. Read the outcome with DesignSteel.GetSummaryResults.

SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadPoint.description: Retrieve the point load assignments of a frame object, a group, or all frames
SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadPoint.signature: (Name, NumberItems, FrameName, LoadPat, MyType, CSys, Dir, RelDist, Dist, Val, ItemType) -> [NumberItems, FrameName[], LoadPat[], MyType[], CSys[], Dir[], RelDist[], Dist[], Val[], ret_code]
SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadPoint.parameter_notes: MyType: 1 force, 2 moment. Dir: 1 to 3 local axes, 4 to 6 global X Y Z, 7 to 9 projected global, 10 gravity, 11 projected gravity. RelDist = distance from the I-end as a fraction of the frame length. Dist = the same distance in length units. Val = load magnitude. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.FrameObj.GetLoadPoint.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 8 parallel arrays then ret_code. Pairs with FrameObj.SetLoadPoint, which has a verified wrapper.

SapModel.PointObj.GetSpring.description: Retrieve the six uncoupled spring stiffnesses assigned to a point object
SapModel.PointObj.GetSpring.parameter_notes: Name = existing point object. K = array of 6 stiffnesses in the order U1, U2, U3, R1, R2, R3, expressed in the point local coordinate system and the present units.
SapModel.PointObj.GetSpring.notes: ByRef output: [K(6), ret_code]. Returns zeros when the point has no spring, so a zero result means no support rather than a read failure. Coupled springs assigned with SetSpringCoupled are not reported here.

SapModel.AreaObj.GetSpring.description: Retrieve the area spring assignments of an area object
SapModel.AreaObj.GetSpring.signature: (Name, NumberSprings, MyType, S, SimpleSpringType, LinkProp, Face, SpringLocalOneType, Dir, Outward, VecX, VecY, VecZ, CSys, Ang) -> [NumberSprings, MyType[], S[], SimpleSpringType[], LinkProp[], Face[], SpringLocalOneType[], Dir[], Outward[], VecX[], VecY[], VecZ[], CSys[], Ang[], ret_code]
SapModel.AreaObj.GetSpring.parameter_notes: MyType: 1 simple spring, 2 link property. S = spring stiffness per unit area, used only when MyType is 1. SimpleSpringType: 1 resists tension and compression, 2 compression only, 3 tension only. LinkProp = link property name, used only when MyType is 2. Face: -1 bottom, -2 top, or a positive edge number. SpringLocalOneType: 1 parallel to a local axis, 2 normal to the face, 3 user-specified direction vector. VecX, VecY and VecZ define that vector in coordinate system CSys.
SapModel.AreaObj.GetSpring.notes: ByRef output: NumberSprings then 13 parallel arrays then ret_code, the widest ByRef layout among the area object getters. Area springs are how Winkler soil support is modelled under mat foundations.

SapModel.FrameObj.GetSpring.description: Retrieve the line spring assignments of a frame object
SapModel.FrameObj.GetSpring.signature: (Name, NumberSprings, MyType, S, SimpleSpringType, LinkProp, SpringLocalOneType, Dir, Plane23Angle, VecX, VecY, VecZ, CSys, Ang) -> [NumberSprings, MyType[], S[], SimpleSpringType[], LinkProp[], SpringLocalOneType[], Dir[], Plane23Angle[], VecX[], VecY[], VecZ[], CSys[], Ang[], ret_code]
SapModel.FrameObj.GetSpring.parameter_notes: MyType: 1 simple spring, 2 link property. S = spring stiffness per unit length, used only when MyType is 1. SimpleSpringType: 1 resists tension and compression, 2 compression only, 3 tension only. LinkProp = link property name, used only when MyType is 2. SpringLocalOneType: 1 parallel to a local axis, 2 in the 2-3 plane at Plane23Angle, 3 user-specified direction vector given by VecX, VecY and VecZ in coordinate system CSys.
SapModel.FrameObj.GetSpring.notes: ByRef output: NumberSprings then 12 parallel arrays then ret_code. Line springs along a pile shaft are how lateral soil resistance is modelled.

SapModel.Func.GetNameList.description: Get the names of the defined functions, optionally filtered by function type
SapModel.Func.GetNameList.parameter_notes: NumberNames and MyName are ByRef outputs, pass 0 and [] as placeholders. FuncType filters the list: 0 all functions, 1 response spectrum, 2 time history, 3 power spectral density, 4 steady state.
SapModel.Func.GetNameList.notes: ByRef output: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. Pair it with SapModel.Func.GetValues to read the data points of each function returned.

SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI_1.description: Retrieve the case type, subtype, design type and auto flag of a load case
SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI_1.signature: (Name, CaseType, SubType, DesignType, DesignTypeOption, Auto) -> [CaseType, SubType, DesignType, DesignTypeOption, Auto, ret_code]
SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI_1.parameter_notes: Name = existing load case. CaseType is an eLoadCaseType value, for example linear static, modal, response spectrum or nonlinear static. SubType further distinguishes cases of the same type, such as eigen versus Ritz for a modal case. DesignType is an eLoadPatternType value. DesignTypeOption: 1 program determined, 2 user specified. Auto reports whether the case was generated automatically by the program.
SapModel.LoadCases.GetTypeOAPI_1.notes: ByRef output: 5 values then ret_code. Newer overload of GetTypeOAPI. The plain VB name GetType is not reachable through the .NET COM interface, so use GetTypeOAPI or this overload.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetAutoSeismicCode.description: Get the name of the auto seismic code assigned to a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetAutoSeismicCode.parameter_notes: Name = existing load pattern. CodeName = the auto seismic code identifier returned ByRef, for example the Eurocode 8 2004 or user coefficient designation.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetAutoSeismicCode.notes: ByRef output: [CodeName, ret_code]. CodeName comes back blank when the pattern carries no auto seismic load. This is the correct entry point for the code name: the cAutoSeismic interface has no GetAutoCode method despite what some older examples suggest. Use the returned name to choose which AutoSeismic getter to call next.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetAutoWindCode.description: Get the name of the auto wind code assigned to a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetAutoWindCode.parameter_notes: Name = existing load pattern. CodeName = the auto wind code identifier returned ByRef, for example the Eurocode 1 2005 designation.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.GetAutoWindCode.notes: ByRef output: [CodeName, ret_code]. CodeName comes back blank when the pattern carries no auto wind load. This is the correct entry point for the code name: the cAutoWind interface has no GetAutoCode method. Use the returned name to choose which AutoWind getter to call next.

SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadSurfacePressure.description: Retrieve the surface pressure load assignments of an area object, a group, or all areas
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadSurfacePressure.signature: (Name, NumberItems, AreaName, LoadPat, Face, Value, PatternName, ItemType) -> [NumberItems, AreaName[], LoadPat[], Face[], Value[], PatternName[], ret_code]
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadSurfacePressure.parameter_notes: Face: -1 bottom face, -2 top face, or a positive edge number. Value = pressure in force per unit area, acting normal to the face. PatternName = joint pattern used to vary the pressure over the area, blank when the pressure is uniform. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadSurfacePressure.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 5 parallel arrays then ret_code. Surface pressure is the usual way to apply hydrostatic or soil pressure, driven by a joint pattern.

SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadTemperature.description: Retrieve the temperature load assignments of an area object, a group, or all areas
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadTemperature.signature: (Name, NumberItems, AreaName, LoadPat, MyType, Value, PatternName, ItemType) -> [NumberItems, AreaName[], LoadPat[], MyType[], Value[], PatternName[], ret_code]
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadTemperature.parameter_notes: MyType: 1 uniform temperature change, 2 temperature gradient along local axis 3, 3 temperature gradient along local axis 2. Value = temperature or temperature gradient in the present units. PatternName = joint pattern that varies the temperature over the area, blank when uniform. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.AreaObj.GetLoadTemperature.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 5 parallel arrays then ret_code.

SapModel.PatternDef.GetNameList.description: Get the names of all joint patterns defined in the model
SapModel.PatternDef.GetNameList.parameter_notes: Both items are ByRef outputs. Call with placeholders, e.g. GetNameList(0, []).
SapModel.PatternDef.GetNameList.notes: ByRef output: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. Joint patterns hold a scalar value at each joint and are what surface pressure and temperature loads reference through their PatternName argument, for example to vary hydrostatic pressure with depth.

SapModel.AreaElm.Count.description: Count the area elements in the analysis model
SapModel.AreaElm.Count.notes: Returns the count directly as a Long, not a return code, so do not test it against 0. Area elements are the meshed counterpart of area objects and exist only after the analysis model has been created, so this returns 0 on an unanalyzed model even when area objects exist. Use SapModel.AreaObj.Count for the object count.

SapModel.FrameObj.GetMass.description: Retrieve the additional mass per unit length assigned to a frame object
SapModel.FrameObj.GetMass.parameter_notes: Name = existing frame object. MassOverL = additional mass per unit length in the present units, returned ByRef.
SapModel.FrameObj.GetMass.notes: ByRef output: [MassOverL, ret_code]. This is the added mass only. It excludes the self mass computed from the section and material, so a frame with no added mass returns 0 rather than its structural mass.

SapModel.SourceMass.GetNameList.description: Get the names of all mass sources defined in the model
SapModel.SourceMass.GetNameList.parameter_notes: Both items are ByRef outputs. Call with placeholders, e.g. GetNameList(0, []).
SapModel.SourceMass.GetNameList.notes: ByRef output: [NumberNames, MyName[], ret_code]. A model can hold several named mass sources while only one is the default; read that one with SourceMass.GetDefault and its content with SourceMass.GetMassSource.

SapModel.LoadCases.Moving.GetLoads.description: Retrieve the vehicle class loads assigned to a moving load case
SapModel.LoadCases.Moving.GetLoads.signature: (Name, NumberLoads, VehClass, SF, Min, Max) -> [NumberLoads, VehClass[], SF[], Min[], Max[], ret_code]
SapModel.LoadCases.Moving.GetLoads.parameter_notes: Name = existing moving load case. VehClass = vehicle class names. SF = scale factor for each class. Min and Max = minimum and maximum number of lanes loaded by that class.
SapModel.LoadCases.Moving.GetLoads.notes: ByRef output: NumberLoads then 4 parallel arrays then ret_code. Moving load cases need lanes and vehicle classes, which SAP2000 defines through the bridge modeller rather than through a cSapModel property, so this getter is only useful on a model built with those features present.

SapModel.GetProjectInfo.description: Retrieve the project information items and their values
SapModel.GetProjectInfo.parameter_notes: All three items are ByRef outputs. Item holds the field names shown in the Project Information dialog, such as Company Name, Client Name, Project Name, Model Name, Engineer and Design Code. Data holds the matching values.
SapModel.GetProjectInfo.notes: ByRef output: [NumberItems, Item[], Data[], ret_code]. Values are blank until someone fills the dialog, so an empty Data entry means the field was never filled rather than a read failure. Write values back with SapModel.SetProjectInfo.

SapModel.PropFrame.GetSectProps.description: Retrieve the computed geometric section properties of a frame section
SapModel.PropFrame.GetSectProps.signature: (Name, Area, As2, As3, Torsion, I22, I33, S22, S33, Z22, Z33, R22, R33) -> [Area, As2, As3, Torsion, I22, I33, S22, S33, Z22, Z33, R22, R33, ret_code]
SapModel.PropFrame.GetSectProps.parameter_notes: Name = existing frame section property. Area = cross-sectional area. As2 and As3 = shear areas in the local 2 and 3 directions. Torsion = torsional constant. I22 and I33 = moments of inertia. S22 and S33 = elastic section moduli. Z22 and Z33 = plastic section moduli. R22 and R33 = radii of gyration. All values are in the present units.
SapModel.PropFrame.GetSectProps.notes: ByRef output: 12 values then ret_code. These are the gross geometric properties of the section, reported before the modifiers set by PropFrame.SetModifiers are applied, so they will not match the stiffness the analysis actually uses when modifiers differ from 1.

SapModel.PropFrame.GetTypeOAPI.description: Get the section type of a frame section property
SapModel.PropFrame.GetTypeOAPI.parameter_notes: Name = existing frame section property. PropType is an eFramePropType value returned ByRef, identifying the shape family such as I-section, channel, tee, angle, rectangular, circle, pipe, tube or general.
SapModel.PropFrame.GetTypeOAPI.notes: ByRef output: [PropType, ret_code]. Call it first to decide which PropFrame getter applies, since PropFrame.GetRectangle and its siblings fail when the section is of a different shape.

SapModel.FrameObj.SetSpring.description: Assign a line spring to a frame object, a group, or the selected frames
SapModel.FrameObj.SetSpring.signature: (Name, MyType, S, SimpleSpringType, LinkProp, SpringLocalOneType, Dir, Plane23Angle, Vec, Ang, Replace, CSys, ItemType) -> ret_code
SapModel.FrameObj.SetSpring.parameter_notes: MyType: 1 simple spring, 2 link property. S = spring stiffness per unit length, used only when MyType is 1. SimpleSpringType: 1 resists tension and compression, 2 compression only, 3 tension only. LinkProp = link property name, used only when MyType is 2. SpringLocalOneType: 1 parallel to a local axis, 2 in the 2-3 plane at Plane23Angle, 3 user vector. Vec = 3-element direction vector used when SpringLocalOneType is 3. Replace True removes existing springs first, False adds to them. ItemType: 0 object, 1 group, 2 selected objects.
SapModel.FrameObj.SetSpring.notes: Vec is declared ByRef in the API but carries no output, so pass a 3-element list. Read the assignment back with FrameObj.GetSpring, whose argument order differs: CSys and Ang come last there.

SapModel.PropMaterial.GetWeightAndMass.description: Get the weight per unit volume and mass per unit volume of a material
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetWeightAndMass.parameter_notes: Name = existing material property. W = weight per unit volume. M = mass per unit volume. Both are ByRef outputs in the present units. Temp = temperature at which the properties are read, used only for temperature-dependent materials.
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetWeightAndMass.notes: ByRef output: [W, M, ret_code]. W and M are independent inputs in SAP2000, not derived from one another, so a model can carry a weight density that is inconsistent with its mass density. Check both when validating a model against a report.

SapModel.PropMaterial.GetOConcrete_1.description: Retrieve the concrete material property data, including the stress-strain curve parameters
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetOConcrete_1.signature: (Name, Fc, IsLightweight, FcsFactor, SSType, SSHysType, StrainAtFc, StrainUltimate, FinalSlope, FrictionAngle, DilatationalAngle, Temp) -> [Fc, IsLightweight, FcsFactor, SSType, SSHysType, StrainAtFc, StrainUltimate, FinalSlope, FrictionAngle, DilatationalAngle, ret_code]
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetOConcrete_1.parameter_notes: Name = existing concrete material. Fc = compressive strength. IsLightweight = Boolean. FcsFactor = shear strength reduction factor, used only for lightweight concrete. SSType: 1 user defined, 2 parametric Mander, 3 parametric simple. SSHysType = hysteresis model. StrainAtFc = strain at peak stress. StrainUltimate = ultimate strain. FinalSlope = slope of the descending branch, zero or negative. FrictionAngle and DilatationalAngle apply to the Drucker-Prager model. Temp is an input, not an output, used for temperature-dependent materials.
SapModel.PropMaterial.GetOConcrete_1.notes: ByRef output: 10 values then ret_code. Temp is passed in and does not appear in the output tuple. Pairs with PropMaterial.SetOConcrete_1, which has a verified wrapper.

SapModel.EditPoint.ChangeCoordinates_1.description: Move a point object to new coordinates, optionally deferring the view refresh
SapModel.EditPoint.ChangeCoordinates_1.parameter_notes: Name = existing point object. X, Y and Z = new coordinates in the present units and the global coordinate system. NoRefresh True skips the view redraw.
SapModel.EditPoint.ChangeCoordinates_1.notes: No ByRef outputs. NoRefresh True is much faster when moving many points in a loop; call SapModel.View.RefreshView once at the end. Everything attached to the point, including frames and areas, follows it.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetEur.description: Retrieve the Eurocode 8 2004 auto seismic load parameters of a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetEur.signature: (Name, DirFlag, Eccen, PeriodFlag, Ct, UserT, UserZ, TopZ, BottomZ, EURO2004Country, EURO2004SpectrumType, EURO2004GroundType, EURO2004Ag, EURO2004S, EURO2004Tb, EURO2004Tc, EURO2004Td, EURO2004Beta, EURO2004Q, EURO2004Lambda) -> [19 values, ret_code]
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetEur.parameter_notes: DirFlag: 1 global X, 2 global Y, 3 global X with eccentricity, 4 global Y with eccentricity. Eccen = ratio of accidental eccentricity. PeriodFlag selects how the fundamental period is obtained, with Ct the approximate period coefficient and UserT the user period. UserZ True means TopZ and BottomZ were user specified. Country, SpectrumType and GroundType use the same codes as Func.FuncRS.GetEurocode82004_1. Ag = design ground acceleration, S = soil factor, Tb Tc Td = corner periods, Beta = lower bound factor, Q = behaviour factor, Lambda = correction factor.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoSeismic.GetEur.notes: ByRef output: 19 values then ret_code, the widest ByRef layout in the Load_Patterns category. This is the load pattern side of Eurocode 8; the response spectrum curve itself is Func.FuncRS.GetEurocode82004_1, and the two are independent definitions.

SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoWind.GetEuroco.description: Retrieve the Eurocode 1 2005 auto wind load parameters of a load pattern
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoWind.GetEuroco.signature: (Name, ExposureFrom, DirAngle, Cpw, Cpl, UserZ, TopZ, BottomZ, WindSpeed, Terrain, Orography, K1, CsCd, Rho, UserExposure) -> [14 values, ret_code]
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoWind.GetEuroco.parameter_notes: ExposureFrom selects the surface the wind acts on, such as diaphragm extents or area objects. DirAngle = wind direction angle in degrees. Cpw and Cpl = windward and leeward pressure coefficients. UserZ True means TopZ and BottomZ were user specified. WindSpeed = basic wind velocity. Terrain = terrain category. Orography = orography factor. K1 = turbulence factor. CsCd = structural factor. Rho = air density. UserExposure True means exposure parameters are user specified.
SapModel.LoadPatterns.AutoWind.GetEuroco.notes: ByRef output: 14 values then ret_code. Confirm the pattern uses this code first with LoadPatterns.GetAutoWindCode, since calling the wrong getter returns a nonzero code.

SapModel.PointObj.GetConnectivity.description: List the objects connected to a point object
SapModel.PointObj.GetConnectivity.signature: (Name, NumberItems, ObjectType, ObjectName, PointNumber) -> [NumberItems, ObjectType[], ObjectName[], PointNumber[], ret_code]
SapModel.PointObj.GetConnectivity.parameter_notes: Name = existing point object. ObjectType: 2 frame, 3 cable, 4 tendon, 5 area, 6 solid, 7 link. ObjectName = name of the connected object. PointNumber = which point of that object coincides with this one, for example 1 for the I-end of a frame.
SapModel.PointObj.GetConnectivity.notes: ByRef output: NumberItems then 3 parallel arrays then ret_code. Use it to find orphan joints: a point with NumberItems equal to 0 is connected to nothing.

SapObject.Hide.description: Hide the SAP2000 application window (removed from screen and taskbar)
SapObject.Hide.notes: Called on SapObject (cOAPI), not on SapModel. Returns nonzero if the application is already hidden. Restore the window with SapObject.Unhide.

SapModel.Func.FuncRS.GetEurocode82004_1.description: Retrieve the parameters of a Eurocode 8 2004 response spectrum function
SapModel.Func.FuncRS.GetEurocode82004_1.signature: (Name, EURO2004Country, EURO2004Direction, EURO2004SpectrumType, EURO2004GroundType, EURO2004ag, EURO2004S, EURO2004AvgoverAg, EURO2004Tb, EURO2004Tc, EURO2004Td, EURO2004Beta, EURO2004q, DampRatio) -> [Country, Direction, SpectrumType, GroundType, ag, S, AvgoverAg, Tb, Tc, Td, Beta, q, DampRatio, ret_code]
SapModel.Func.FuncRS.GetEurocode82004_1.parameter_notes: Name = existing Eurocode 8 2004 response spectrum function. All other items are ByRef outputs with the same meaning and codes as SetEurocode82004_1.
SapModel.Func.FuncRS.GetEurocode82004_1.notes: ByRef output: 13 values then ret_code as raw[-1]. Fails with a nonzero code if Name is not a Eurocode 8 2004 function. Use SapModel.Func.GetValues to read the resulting period-acceleration pairs.

SapModel.Func.FuncRS.SetEurocode82004_1.description: Define a Eurocode 8 2004 response spectrum function
SapModel.Func.FuncRS.SetEurocode82004_1.signature: (Name, EURO2004Country, EURO2004Direction, EURO2004SpectrumType, EURO2004GroundType, EURO2004ag, EURO2004S, EURO2004AvgoverAg, EURO2004Tb, EURO2004Tc, EURO2004Td, EURO2004Beta, EURO2004q, DampRatio) -> ret_code
SapModel.Func.FuncRS.SetEurocode82004_1.parameter_notes: Name = new or existing function. Country: 0 Other (user NDPs), 1 CEN Default, 5 Norway, 6 Singapore, 10 Portugal. Direction: 1 horizontal, 2 vertical. SpectrumType: 1 Type 1, 2 Type 2. GroundType: 1..6 = A..F, horizontal direction only. ag = design ground acceleration, S = soil factor, AvgoverAg = vertical/horizontal ratio, Tb/Tc/Td = corner periods in seconds, Beta = lower-bound factor, q = behaviour factor, DampRatio = damping ratio.
SapModel.Func.FuncRS.SetEurocode82004_1.notes: The trailing _1 is the newer overload; the older SetEurocode82004 takes fewer parameters. S, Tb, Tc, Td and Beta are only read when Country = 0 (user-specified NDPs).

SapModel.Analyze.DeleteResults.description: Delete analysis results for one load case, or for every load case
SapModel.Analyze.DeleteResults.parameter_notes: Name = name of an existing load case whose results are deleted; ignored when All is True. All = Boolean, optional, default False; True deletes results for all load cases.
SapModel.Analyze.DeleteResults.notes: Deleting results unlocks the model. Pass an empty Name together with All=True to clear everything.

SapModel.PropFrame.SetModifiers.description: Assign the eight stiffness, mass and weight modifiers to a frame section property
SapModel.PropFrame.SetModifiers.parameter_notes: Name = existing frame section property. Value = array of 8 unitless modifiers: [0] cross-sectional area, [1] shear area in local 2, [2] shear area in local 3, [3] torsional constant, [4] moment of inertia about local 2, [5] moment of inertia about local 3, [6] mass, [7] weight. Default is 1.0 for every modifier.
SapModel.PropFrame.SetModifiers.notes: Applies to the section property, so it affects every frame object using that section. Object-level overrides use SapModel.FrameObj.SetModifiers instead.

SapModel.PropFrame.GetModifiers.description: Retrieve the eight modifiers assigned to a frame section property
SapModel.PropFrame.GetModifiers.parameter_notes: Name = existing frame section property. Value = array of 8 unitless modifiers returned ByRef, in the same order as SetModifiers: area, shear area 2, shear area 3, torsional constant, I about 2, I about 3, mass, weight.
SapModel.PropFrame.GetModifiers.notes: ByRef output: [Value(8), ret_code]. Returns 1.0 for every modifier when none has been assigned.

SapModel.Func.FuncTH.SetSine.description: Define a sine-type time history function
SapModel.Func.FuncTH.SetSine.parameter_notes: Name = new or existing function. SineP = period in seconds. SineSteps = steps per cycle, cannot be less than 8. SineCycles = number of cycles. SineAmp = amplitude.
SapModel.Func.FuncTH.SetSine.notes: Returns a bare Long, not a tuple, so read the return code directly rather than with raw[-1]. Generates SineSteps * SineCycles + 1 points; read them back with SapModel.Func.GetValues. Verified 2026-09-04: period 1.0 s, 16 steps, 4 cycles produced 65 points ending at 4.0 s.

SapModel.Func.GetValues.description: Retrieve the time and value data point pairs of any defined function
SapModel.Func.GetValues.signature: (Name, NumberItems, MyTime, Value) -> [NumberItems, MyTime[], Value[], ret_code]
SapModel.Func.GetValues.parameter_notes: Name = any existing function of any family (RS, TH, PSD, SS). NumberItems = number of pairs returned ByRef. MyTime = abscissa array, in seconds for response spectrum and time history, in cycles per second for power spectral density and steady state. Value = ordinate array. Call with placeholders, e.g. GetValues(name, 0, [], []).
SapModel.Func.GetValues.notes: ByRef output: [NumberItems, MyTime[], Value[], ret_code]. Lives on the Func parent object, not on FuncRS or FuncTH. Verified 2026-09-04 by verify_Func_GetValues: a 5-point user response spectrum round-tripped exactly, a sine time history returned 65 points ending at 4.0 s, and an undefined name returned 1 rather than an empty array.
